_about: Five real-layout claim emails, anonymized. Each case stores the two MIME parts of a Gmail
forward: <slug>.txt is Gmail's text/plain rendering (close to _html_to_plain output, i.e. the
regex/arm-(a) input) and <slug>.html is Gmail's rewrite of the insurer's XHTML (head/style
dropped, class names prefixed with the message id; close to the attribute-stripped arm (b')).
Neither part is byte-identical to a direct insurer email, whose text/plain part IS the XHTML.
Gmail-forward artifacts to expect in .txt: a hand-typed annotation line at the top, the
'---------- Forwarded message ---------' preamble, '[image: Imagen 1]', hard wraps at ~76
columns, U+200E marks, and (comunicacion_perito_ip) a Google-Maps link inserted after the
address. Every name, NIF, phone, e-mail, street, town, policy and claim number is fictional;
insurer brand, amounts, dates and coverage boilerplate are unchanged.
The six gestion_perito_* cases (added 2026-10-02) are NOT Gmail forwards: they are the two
MIME parts of the insurer's original Outlook email exactly as the Gmail API serves them (UTF-8,
QP soft breaks joined), anonymized from the operator's original .eml (real_a) or rebuilt in that
shape (real_b, four synthetic). Expert names, phones, e-mails, refs and the privacy-policy host
are fictional; the AVISO LEGAL boilerplate is unchanged.
provenance: Forwarded by the collaborator to the dev mailbox on 2026-09-09; anonymized 2026-09-14.
gold_status: CONFIRMED by the operator 2026-09-14 against the original emails, applying field_rules.

field_rules.insurance_company: Compañía: in Datos de la Entidad
field_rules.owner_name: Tomador: in Datos del Asegurado, verbatim (surname-comma-name order kept)
field_rules.address: Dirección: in Datos del Siniestro; fall back to the Asegurado's Dirección in Implicados only when blank
field_rules.phone_number: the Asegurado's Tfno in Implicados (the single implicado for asistencia); never Interviene or Perjudicado
field_rules.description: Descripción: in Datos del Siniestro only, never spilling into Implicados
field_rules.observaciones: Comunicación a colaborador: the Observaciones: body text. Gestión con Perito: the body from its start up to (excluding) AVISO LEGAL, or the whole body when absent. Null for every other type

cases.notes: Synthetic, derived from tests/data/asitur_xhtml_sample.html (the production text/plain-that-is-XHTML shape — .html is the XHTML, .txt is the converter's output, i.e. exactly what the LLM sees under arm a). Added 2026-09-15 after the staging live run: the siniestro 'Dirección:' line is BLANK and the field rule says to fall back to the Asegurado's 'Dirección:' under Implicados; the model returned null on the first live run (the five real fixtures all have a filled siniestro address, so the rule was never exercised). Regex returns '' here (its anchor matches the blank line), hence regex_known_failures=address. Description spans three lines up to 'Tipo:' (hard wraps joined).
